title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
summary: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
summary: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
summary: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.

title: Crypto Sleuth ZachXBT Fronted $350K to Pose as a Client of Lazarus' Chinese Launderers
summary: The on-chain sleuth says he posed as a customer of a Chinese crime syndicate, fronting $349,700 and eating 5% on every order, to track Lazarus Group's Bybit loot in real time.

title: SEC Clears 3x Leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum Funds for Trading
summary: The agency approved a Cboe rule letting six Volatility Shares funds that triple the daily moves of Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, oil, and natural gas list on a U.S. exchange.

title: CFTC Unveils Plan to Bring Crypto Exchanges Under Federal Oversight
summary: The CFTC is seeking public comment on a framework that would create a new federal license for crypto exchanges, with leverage offers as the trigger for oversight.

title: Bitcoin Just Flashed a Second, Stronger Golden Cross: Here's What That Means
summary: The Bitcoin rally keeps bumping into the same wall, but a classic bullish signal suggests the trend is built to last.

title: Bitmine Buys $41M More Ethereum, Reaching 99% of Its 'Alchemy of 5%' Target
summary: The purchase lifts Bitmine's stash past 6 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its "Alchemy of 5%" goal—as chairman Tom Lee says Ethereum is "dwarfing" other macro assets.

title: Strategy Posts $21B Q3 Gain, Buys $29M in BTC, Repurchases $176M in STRC
summary: The firm's Bitcoin holdings hit a record 848,000 BTC, while the quarterly gain is a fair-value mark carrying $1.88 billion in deferred tax.

title: Metaplanet Sold 10,000 Bitcoin and Bought Back 11,000 to Prove a Point
summary: Rating agencies ask if a Bitcoin company will actually sell when obligations fall due. "We answered by doing it," said CEO Simon Gerovich.

title: Morning Minute: Uptober Off to a Green Start
summary: Crypto majors and alts are rallying to start October. What’s driving the early action and will it continue?

title: Greek Soldiers Among Alleged Leaders of $8M Crypto Pyramid Scheme
summary: An association for AI enthusiasts was allegedly the recruiting vehicle, and two anonymous tips to a government portal started the case.

title: OKX and NYSE Owner ICE Plan 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading Under SEC Exemption
summary: Filed under the SEC's new Innovation Exemption, the notice lists more than 60 stocks, including Nvidia and SpaceX, paired with stablecoins.

title: Trump Taps Jay Clayton, the SEC Chair Who Sued Ripple, to Lead AI Push
summary: President Trump named a new "Super Intelligence Force" to coordinate federal AI policy, with Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton at the helm. As SEC chair, Clayton launched crypto lawsuits including the agency's case against Ripple.

title: Banking Group Sues to Block Crypto's 'Side Door' Into the Banking System
summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America argues the OCC's national trust charters give crypto firms a "side door into the banking system" without the safeguards that bind traditional banks.

title: 'Uptober' Starts Green as Bitcoin ETFs Draw $134 Million
summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $134.4 million over the first two trading days of October, rebounding from a Sept. 30 outflow as a weak jobs report cooled Fed rate-hike bets.

title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
summary: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

title: Trump Is Hosting Yet Another Meme Coin Dinner: Here Are the Details
summary: The TRUMP meme coin project is inviting its top 185 holders to a Nov. 22 gala dinner with President Trump two weeks after ethics disputes over his crypto interests helped stall the Clarity Act in the Senate.

title: Ethereum Now Lets You Pay for AI Without Revealing Who You Are
summary: Ethereum's zkAPI lets users prepay in USDC and query AI models through cryptographic proofs, so no single party sees both who they are and what they ask.

title: Circle Pushes Back on MiCA's Bank-Deposit Mandate for Stablecoins
summary: The USDC issuer told the European Commission that MiCA's reserve mandates and concentration caps keep the largest global stablecoins outside Europe's perimeter—siding with the ECB in calling for more flexible rules.

title: Once a $2.3 Billion Network, Ethereum Layer-2 Blast Is Shutting Down
summary: Blast said operating costs now exceed the revenue its Ethereum layer-2 generates and asked users to withdraw their assets to mainnet before Oct. 26.
